title: #1838 follow-up: the git-after-cd guard's `&&` block and `if` false alarms, and its `_exits_on_failure` mutants
why: Follow-up of #1838 in lane session_013NEJL1Eaa8LA5StpPbWgvA (step git-write-after-failed-cd): the guard gives false alarms on `&&` blocks and `if` forms, and `_exits_on_failure` has surviving mutants (coordinator, 04:26 CST Nov 8).
note: Fix: the guard reads a cd inside an `&&` block or an `if` test as one that stops the chain on failure, and tests kill the `_exits_on_failure` mutants. Red cases first: each false-alarm form is refused today; control: a git write joined by ';' after a cd still refuses. The lane gives the exact forms in its PR. Lane session_013NEJL1Eaa8LA5StpPbWgvA. Queue fix. Filed 04:30 CST Nov 8.
